components.name: ContextMenu
components.summary: The viewport's right-click menu and its submenus (Add Brush, Add Entity, Apply Entity → func → class).

components.name: EntityProperties
components.summary: Entity properties: class picker (category and class), spawnflags checkboxes and a raw key–value table.

components.name: ObjectPreview
components.summary: A preview of the selected object's texture at the top of the properties panel.

components.name: PanelTabs
components.summary: A tab row for switching panel content and maximizing a view.

components.name: TextureBrowser
components.summary: The texture browser: folder and texture count in the title, a name filter, an In use filter, thumbnails, and the selected texture's details in the footer.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: The top toolbar: file, undo/redo, tool modes, CSG commands, grid size, Tex Lock and Compile.

components.name: ViewportPane
components.summary: A view's frame: a title bar (name, axes or cursor coordinates, maximize button) over a WebGL canvas drawn in the vp-* colors.

components.name: Workspace
components.summary: The editor's default layout: toolbar, 2 × 2 views, properties panel on the right, and textures and log at the bottom.
